_doc: 0.6. The Sydney Engine: active ragdolls. One block per kind of body (human, infected, giant). motors: per joint class a natural frequency in Hz, a damping ratio and a torque limit in newton metres (gains follow from the inertia the joint carries: torque = stiffness x pose error - damping x joint velocity, clamped to the limit). strength scales every limit. balance: ankleLever is how far (m) planted feet can shift the point of support; gain how hard they chase the capture point; stepThreshold how far outside that reach the capture point must be before a step is taken; stepTime/stepReach/stepLift/stepOvershoot/stepLead/stepForce shape the step; maxSteps is how many it gets; fallTilt (degrees), fallHeight (share of standing height) and lostReach (m) are where balance is given up; recoverSettle is the quiet time before the body is its own again. fall: strength kept while falling, brace 0..1 how much it reaches for the ground, downStrength muscle tone lying, downMin/downPerForce/downMax how long it lies, holdWound whether a hand goes to the wound, deathFade how long the muscles take to let go. getUp: time, strength (multiples of body weight the legs can push), timeout, tries. response: stagger and knockdown multiply the force it takes to stagger or floor this body relative to a person.
